Numbers calibrated to sim/best-config.json: find cash 3+eraIdx, objective rep by mystery tier within the era band, plunder scar [1,1,1,2,2,3,3], sell disrepute max(1,floor((rep-1)/2)), doomed=0. Step counts per eraStepBands [3,3,4,4,5,5,5]; reqs gentle (1 shallow, 2 prehistoric, 5 ManyWorlds). All provisional — playtest, don't defend.

cards.name: The Phaistos Spiral
cards.fiction: A clay disc stamped in a spiral with signs no scholar can read, alone of its kind. Copy both faces before the palace burns around it.

steps.text: Find the disc in the palace stores
Move through the palace unseen
Study the spiral of stamped signs
Take a careful impression
Copy both faces before the palace burns

cards.name: The Sea Peoples
cards.fiction: Raiders no one could name brought a dozen kingdoms down in a single generation. Read the last tablets baked in the burning city before it falls.

steps.text: Find the archive in the burning city
Reach it as the raiders close in
Sort the diplomatic tablets
Save the tablets from the flames
Read who brought the kingdoms down

cards.name: The Mercury Sea
cards.fiction: The first emperor's tomb, sealed over rivers of mercury and a buried army. Map the chamber — or breach it and take what the crossbows guard.

steps.text: Read the court records for the tomb's plan
Cross the mercury moat's poisoned vapours
Disarm the buried crossbow triggers
Map the mercury rivers and their strange currents
Breach the sealed inner chamber

cards.name: The Ninth
cards.fiction: Five thousand legionaries marched north into the mist and vanished from every roll. Recover the fort’s last muster before the record is struck out.

steps.text: Find the fort's record room
March north into the mist
Trace the legion's last orders
Break into the strong-room
Recover the last muster before it's struck out

cards.name: The Sky Drawings
cards.fiction: Lines miles long, shaped into creatures only the sky can see in full. Survey them before the desert wind blurs their edges for good.

steps.text: Find your bearings on the empty pampa
Walk the lines under the desert sun
Trace a single figure end to end
Map the figures from the heights
Survey them before the wind blurs the edges

cards.name: The Denisovan
cards.fiction: A whole kind of human known from a single fingerbone in a cave. Recover a living trace before the layer is lost to the dig.

steps.text: Place the cave's deep layers in order
Work the unstable dig
Identify the Denisovan layer
Extract the fingerbone intact
Recover a living trace before the layer is lost

cards.name: The First Mark
cards.fiction: A cross-hatch scratched in ochre — the oldest drawing a human hand ever made. Record it before the ochre crumbles to dust.

steps.text: Find the ochre piece in the cave fill
Work the coastal cave
Make out the cross-hatched marks
Steady the crumbling ochre
Record the first mark before it turns to dust

cards.name: The Red Deer People
cards.fiction: People with ancient features who should have been gone for ages, yet were not. Take a specimen before the cave roof comes down.

steps.text: Date the cave's strange remains
Shore up the failing cave roof
Read the ancient features in the bones
Judge how a vanished people survived
Take a specimen before the roof comes down

cards.name: The Long Winter
cards.fiction: A sky-fire that may have plunged the warming world back into ice for a thousand years. Measure the impact layer before the meltwater scours it away.

steps.text: Locate the buried impact horizon
Cross the meltwater channels
Read the dark layer in the ice
Core the impact layer
Measure it before the meltwater scours it
